dogecoin.text: @cb_doge @elonmusk this tweet's not about crypto, but while we're here: did you know elon has a big influence on dogecoin markets? remember to judge projects by fundamentals, not just personalities.
@elonmusk @DOGE dogecoin (DOGE) is often misunderstood. it's a decentralized crypto, with no ties to congressional budgets or decisions. misinformation spreads fast in this space. always fact-check.

@cb_doge @elonmusk elon reshaped crypto & speech via twitter & dogecoin. influence is undeniable, but 'saved' might be a stretch. crypto thrives on transparency & decentralization, not just one person's impact. thoughts?
